temporal_notes: Indoor-resting mosquitoes collected over one week in May 2015
source_text: Indoor-resting mosquitoes were collected using electrical aspirators from 10–15 households each day for a week at Ndjili-Brasserie, a suburb of Kinshasa (4°19′39″S, 15°18′48″E), in May 2015... One hundred thirty-three An. gambiae sensu lato (s.l.) and 79 An. funestus s.l. laid eggs.
